name: Güevéjar (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Güevéjar (a tree on white and figures on red).
history: Güevéjar adopted its arms and flag officially on 9 November 1988; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three equal horizontal stripes, green above, white in the centre and red below, with the arms centred and superimposed.
